title: Mantell's plane disintegrated by magnetism

tellings.quote: Didn't say it had been blown out of the air and then crashed and it said it disintegrated.

plain: In 1948, near Fort Knox in Kentucky, a pilot named Thomas Mantell lost his plane, and a man named Silus Newton offers his own account of what happened. Newton says the record did not say the plane was blown out of the air and then crashed, but that it disintegrated, and he links this to magnetism, which would suggest some unusual force tore the aircraft apart.
